iut_type: End Product (Shimano, unannounced future product), registration public display start date
customer_question: Our product's information won't be revealed until around September next year — can the registration's public display start date be set that far out, given we've heard the maximum delay window changed recently?
question_variants: How far in the future can the registration's public visibility be delayed?
Has the maximum display delay window recently changed?
actual_issue: The customer's product reveal date was roughly nine months away at the time of registration, and they needed to confirm the registration site could actually delay public visibility that far out, especially since they recalled a shorter limit from past experience.
plain_english_explanation: Around mid-2025, alongside an announcement of a registration fee increase effective March 1, 2026, Bluetooth SIG relaxed the previous 90-day maximum display-start-date delay to a new maximum of 180 days. Since the customer's actual product reveal date was still further out than even 180 days, the registration was set to the maximum currently available delay (180 days) to push public visibility as far out as possible, even though it wouldn't fully cover the gap until the customer's actual September reveal date.
consultant_answer: Yes — around mid-2025, alongside the registration fee increase announcement effective March 1, 2026, SIG relaxed the previous 90-day maximum display-start-date delay to 180 days. Since your actual reveal date is further out than even that, we'll set the registration to the maximum currently available delay (180 days) to push public visibility out as far as currently possible, though it won't fully cover the gap until your actual September reveal date.
decision_logic: Registration public display delay should be set to the maximum currently available window when the customer's actual confidential reveal date exceeds that window, since no further delay is possible beyond the platform's current maximum, regardless of how much further out the customer's real timeline extends.
final_recommendation: When a customer's confidential reveal date exceeds even the maximum available registration display delay, clearly set expectations that the registration will become publicly visible before the customer's actual reveal date, since no further extension beyond the platform's current maximum is possible.
risk_if_done_wrong: Assuming the display delay could be set indefinitely to match the customer's actual confidential timeline, rather than the platform's actual current maximum (180 days), could result in unexpectedly early public exposure of an unannounced product.
